newsitem.title: USA: United Tech says probes a standard in opers.
newsitem.headline: United Tech says probes a standard in opers.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said its mention that it will be under government investigations in its quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission has been part of its filings for more than 10 years and is part of doing business with the government.

"The language that is the subject of the story has been in our 10-K for over 10 years and can be found in the 10-K of almost any defense contractor," Peter Murphy, senior manager of public relations at United Technologies, said.
Murphy said the government investigations could also include due diligence for contracts and other business.
"The company is reporting about the business conditions that exist and you'll find it in any firm that does business with the government," Murphy said.
